hooks.command: /bin/sh -c 'command -v tautline >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; f="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tautline-guard.$$"; out=$(tautline builder-guard --hook 2>"$f"); rc=$?; err=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null); rm -f "$f" 2>/dev/null; [ "$rc" -eq 2 ] || exit 0; tautline builder-guard --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; printf "%s\n" "$out"; printf "%s\n" "$err" >&2; exit 2'
